# Flowchart padding × 1.2

User-approved board: sequential; publish new gitnook issue; no commit/push requested.
Isolation: shared working tree. Baseline HEAD c2b49a8, core 2414 tests / board
154 tests passing and both package tsc --noEmit clean, measured 2026-10-15.

## Outcome and contract
Flowchart nodes of every supported shape have about 20% more horizontal and
vertical text-to-frame padding. Scale only padding, never text, line height,
wrap width or full node dimensions. Derive node padding from the existing
TextMeasurer convention: empty width is total horizontal padding; empty
height minus 21px line height is total vertical padding. Zero/negative padding
must not shrink nodes; positive padding increases by 20%. Keep original label
geometry for text drawing and increase the envelope used to size the shape.
Flowchart subgraph padding is 14.4px rather than 12px, including nested frames
and title bands. Other diagram kinds retain their existing geometry and shared
cluster default remains 12px. Existing flowchart paint order stays intact.
No new consumer-facing options; clusterNode may accept caller-specific padding
internally. No change to board/core generic measurers or shared label logic.
Existing custom TextMeasurers remain supported.

## T1 — More breathing room inside flowchart nodes and subgraphs
Status: todo. Blocked by: none. Shared resources: none.
Acceptance criteria:
1. Positive node padding grows by 20% through layoutGraph, across supported
   shapes, multiline labels and custom measurers, without scaling glyphs or
   wrapping width. Zero/negative padding does not cause shrinkage.
2. Subgraphs use 14.4px on sides and in title band, including nested frames.
3. Other kinds and flowchart paint order remain unchanged (regressions).
Seams: layoutGraph output geometry and render output SVG/text/shape geometry;
real ELK and renderer, deterministic local TextMeasurer and jsdom.
Write ownership:
- packages/core/src/layout/layoutGraph.ts
- packages/core/src/layout/layoutGraph.test.ts
- packages/core/src/layout/clusters.ts
- packages/core/src/layout/clusters.test.ts (if needed)
- packages/core/src/index.test.ts (geometry regression updates only)
- packages/core/src/compat/layoutDefects.test.ts (geometry regressions only)
- packages/core/src/compat/corpus.test.ts (geometry regressions only)
- packages/core/CHANGELOG.md
- CONTEXT.md (flowchart-specific padding statement only)
Existing tests explicitly approved to update: flowchart geometry expectations
in these owned files that pin former node dimensions or 12px subgraph padding.
Preserve their behavioral intent and record changed tests in report; do not
weaken containment, routing or other-kind assertions to obtain green.
Focused: pnpm --filter siren-core exec vitest run src/layout/layoutGraph.test.ts
and affected render integration tests if needed.
Suite: pnpm test
Static: pnpm --filter siren-core exec tsc --noEmit;
pnpm --filter siren-board exec tsc --noEmit
E2E: None; geometry observed through layout/render seams.
Unrelated dirty ER parser/tests and compat/corpus.ts belong to other AI.
Do not touch them or git index/history. Capture per-slice red-green evidence
in .scratch/flowchart-padding/execution-report.md.
